paragraphs.text: Emina is a rich noble on Shandalar .

Emina was at one point visited by the wizard Relno . She knew he was about to ask her for more money, and so she gave him the most withering look she could muster to dissuade him. The problem was, she needed Relno's genius. He was the one who made her family wealthy and powerful with his inventions. And so, he mustered his courage and asked for more money.

Emina sighed as only a noble raised to manipulate and subjugate her lessers could sigh. It subtle, disappointed sigh, thick with disgust. But Relno kept his gaze up. There was a long pause, and then Emina rolled her eyes. She asked him the sum, and when he asked for five thousand, she granted it and bid him leave immediately.
